question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

A __diligent__ individual possesses the quality to win every difficulty.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Diligent' **refers to a person who is careful and uses a lot of effort. The English meaning is hardworking, industrious, or careful (परिश्रमी).

 
 
• **Example:** She’s a diligent student and always completes her assignments ahead of time.
 
 
 
• **'Inactive'**, which is the correct answer, means not being involved in physical activity. Its English meaning is not engaging in or involving any or much physical activity (निष्क्रिय).
 
 
• **Example: **If you remain inactive during this quarantine, you'll build up health issues.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Moderate' **refers to something average in amount, intensity, quality, or degree (संयमी).
 
• **'Earnest' **refers to showing sincere and intense conviction (गंभीर).
 
• **'Bustling' **means full of energetic and noisy activity (सरपट).
